Unique cards posted at x2 (Jabba The Hutt, Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle, Jodo Kast, Mara Jade, Dr. Evazan, IG-88 With Riot Gun, 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle, Bossk In Hound's Tooth, Zuckuss In Mist Hunter) are kept as posted.
player_note: The post (30 October 2000) says: 'This is the deck that I used at the MN Grand Slam. It went 3-0 in the Grand Slam and has gone 14-0 in tournament play total.' It also names Jose Grace as the 'MN grand slam winner'.
